title: coursetia ferruginea
intro: Coursetia ferruginea, commonly known as the Ironwood tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Leguminosae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used in various cultures to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Coursetia ferruginea include its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate pain, as well as its antimicrobial properties which help to fight off infections.
